entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I need to return something, my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just... I haven't even opened it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Oh, no, it's nothing like that. I was so excited to use it, but... things have been really difficult. I was just discharged from the hospital yesterday after a sudden emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well.

I'm trying. I had to have unexpected surgery, and with my husband's recent deployment, it's all been a nightmare. The last thing on my mind was this sensor. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really, really need this money back right now.
I completely understand, Sarah, and thank you for sharing that with me. It sounds like you've been through a lot. Let me just pull up our current policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. It looks like you're well within the return window. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline with everything going on.

Not at all. Since you received it only 17 days ago, you have plenty of time. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Is that still correct?
Yes, it is! Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea what a weight that is off my shoulders. I really appreciate your help.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. We're happy we could make things a little easier for you. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again. Happy New Year.
You're very welcome. Happy New Year to you as well, and I wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
